TRIAL RESET TO MAR-16-2022 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF FEB-10-2022 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $110) SERVED FEB-08-2022, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT CASTILLO, ARMANDO

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-16-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-16-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF WAHEDULLAH SAMADI IS PRESENT. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT ARMANDO CASTILLO. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: M. GOODMAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SAMADI, WAHEDULLAH RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CASTILLO, ARMANDO $7,554.00 PRINCIPAL, $185.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,739.00, THIS JUDGMENT IS FOR MEDICAL DAMAGES AND PAIN AND SUFFERING ONLY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED NO EXHIBITS FILED
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-16-2022 - JUDGMENT.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT CASTILLO, ARMANDO
